svg.title: 4. Leaf-spine topology
svg.desc: Two spine switches connect two leaves. Leaf 1 attaches existing compute Nodes 41 and 42; Leaf 2 attaches Node 43. Each Node exposes nic0 and owns four ResourceNode GPU units. Node 41 has four free units; Nodes 42 and 43 each have two free and two allocated units. Blue highlights one usable route from the chosen root, spine-1, through Leaf 2 to Node 43. GpuCandidateFinder combines free GPU units with operational paths and returns node IDs, free GPU IDs, and paths, sorted by latency and Node ID.
